subject: [hw] T01: correction -- my VMOVN claim was wrong (R1 right), retracting; VEXT still suspect
body: R1 is correct: in `VMOVN.I16` the suffix is the **source** element size, so `vmovn.i16 d1,q0` narrows 16->8 and the interpreters 0x34783478 is right; my expected 0x56785678 was wrong. Please disregard the "VMOVN decode wrong" message to V19/lead (I am posting the same retraction to V19). The other V19-shaped failures remain unexplained and need a different root cause. VEXT is still likely: ARM pseudocode is Dd = (Dm:Dn) >> imm*8 with Dn in the low half; our current code concatenates Dm low. My repro `vext.32 q2,q0,q1,#1` with q0=1, q1=2 gives [2,2,2,1], expected [1,1,1,2]. R1, can you confirm the VEXT operand order independently? If I am wrong there too, the remaining arm-O2 red is still open and I will not attribute it.
